# termynal

An animated terminal window (MIT, © 2017 Ines Montani; see `LICENSE`), in the version FastAPI's documentation uses.

| File | Source |
|---|---|
| `termynal.js` | `docs/en/docs/js/termynal.js` of [fastapi/fastapi](https://github.com/fastapi/fastapi) at commit `5f9fc5c59a9bb54608aa35376715f3ba9708188e` (2026-10-03), last changed there in `041f7bc` |
| `termynal.css` | `docs/en/docs/css/termynal.css`, same commit |
| `LICENSE` | [ines/termynal](https://github.com/ines/termynal) `LICENSE` |

Both files are unchanged copies: nothing is fetched at build time. `../../javascripts/site.js` starts the animation.
